correspondence.transform_policy: Positive uniform scale and translation, correspondence only

fresh_correspondence.transform_policy: Positive uniform scale through origin, correspondence only

bind_round_trip.policy: Static original: calibrated FBX matrix/scale precision with angle/head semantics

native_scale_policy: Static original has no gameplay height; native target height must be calibrated separately

material.source: Exact original GLB graph; provider material discarded
material.normal_convention: Original tangent payload unchanged; native convention must be explicit

limitations: No source/provider geometry, rig, weight, animation or transform redesign.
Source/provider geometry uses the separately calibrated 10micron bound; exact source positions are not claimed. Provider-before/after export retains the strict 2micron bound.
Native packed MR wiring, normal/tangent convention and rendered shading still require acceptance.
